hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook that gates pool creation to an internal factory, enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap with automatic surplus refund, and a decaying anti-snipe fee premium on buys. Upon reaching the graduation raise target, the hook executes an inner swap, locks full-range liquidity, and updates the dynamic LP fee to a flat 1%.
